 coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN json_type(TRY_CAST("related_bills_json" AS JSON))='ARRAY' THEN json_array_length(TRY_CAST("related_bills_json" AS JSON)) ELSE 0 END),0) expected_occurrences

 statuses AS (SELECT field_state,count(*) n FROM "bill_related_bills_field_states" GROUP BY field_state)

 (SELECT count(*) FROM "bill_related_bills_occurrences") actual_occurrences,
